Oura.title: Oura terms and conditions changes: Nov 4, 2026 update, arbitration, and history
Oura.desc: Oura's new terms take effect Nov 4, 2026: accept them in the app or lose access. No arbitration opt-out, jury waiver, mass-arbitration batches. Dated history of every Oura terms and privacy change.

Robinhood.title: Robinhood Class Action Service (Nov 18, 2026): auto-enrollment, 20% fee, how to opt out, and terms history
Robinhood.desc: Robinhood's Oct 1, 2026 Customer Agreement auto-enrolls accounts in a Class Action Service from Nov 18 that keeps 20% of settlement payouts. How to unenroll, what rights you give up, and every Robinhood terms and price change.

Google.title: Google privacy policy changes: Oct 16, 2026 Gmail, Photos and Drive ads exception, and history
Google.desc: Google's Oct 16, 2026 privacy policy lets Gmail, Photos and Drive data you connect to Search or Gemini personalize ads. How to disconnect it, plus a dated history of every Google terms and privacy change.

Bank of America.title: Bank of America Online Banking Service Agreement changes: Oct 19, 2026 external account disputes, and history
Bank of America.desc: From Oct 19, 2026, Bank of America won't investigate most errors or fraud on payments that show on your other bank's statement, and the 90-day window now covers only outside-funded Bill Pay. Dated history of BofA terms changes.

Proton.title: Proton terms changes: inactive free account deletion after 12 months, Oct 2026 updates, and history
Proton.desc: Proton can delete free accounts inactive for 12 months, and since Oct 20, 2026 its 30-, 15- and 7-day warnings are only "a mere courtesy." Paid accounts are exempt. Dated history of every Proton terms, price and privacy change.

Slack.desc: Every Slack price change since 2014, dated and sourced: Pro $8.75 per user a month ($7.25 yearly), Business+ $18 ($15 yearly) since June 2025, and Enterprise+ shown at $45 per user a month billed annually. Checked daily.
